episodes.name: Love Letter
episodes.plot: Shin Sol-i isn't shy about her unrequited crush on Cha Heon, her next-door neighbor. One day, she gets an idea to write him the perfect love letter.

translations.value: Shin Sol-i isn't shy about her unrequited crush on Cha Heon, her next-door neighbor. One day, she gets an idea to write him the perfect love letter.

episodes.name: At the Karaoke
episodes.plot: Woo Dae-sung ditches swim practice before a competition for a fun night out at karaoke. When Heon is down, Sol-i wants to be by his side.

translations.value: Woo Dae-sung ditches swim practice before a competition for a fun night out at karaoke. When Heon is down, Sol-i wants to be by his side.

episodes.name: Pick Me Up!
episodes.plot: Sol-i declares she's running for class representative, surprising her friends. While Dae-sung shows his support, Heon disappoints her.

translations.value: Sol-i declares she's running for class representative, surprising her friends. While Dae-sung shows his support, Heon disappoints her.

episodes.name: Field Day
episodes.plot: Desperate for prize money so she can buy Heon a birthday present, Sol-i pours all her energy into winning at the school's sports competition.

translations.value: Desperate for prize money so she can buy Heon a birthday present, Sol-i pours all her energy into winning at the school's sports competition.

episodes.name: Drama Festival (feat. Let's Go, Baby)
episodes.plot: The class prepares to audition for the school play. Sol-i wants to act out a romantic story with Heon, but he's not easy to convince.

translations.value: The class prepares to audition for the school play. Sol-i wants to act out a romantic story with Heon, but he's not easy to convince.

episodes.name: Don't Go
episodes.plot: After the incident at the play, Sol-i begins to avoid Heon and considers a big decision. To cheer her up, Dae-sung puts together something special.

translations.value: After the incident at the play, Sol-i begins to avoid Heon and considers a big decision. To cheer her up, Dae-sung puts together something special.

episodes.name: Game of Truth
episodes.plot: Excited to try out for a TV singing competition, Jeong Jin-hwan asks the friends to come and support him. Sol-i worries when her parents fight.

translations.value: Excited to try out for a TV singing competition, Jeong Jin-hwan asks the friends to come and support him. Sol-i worries when her parents fight.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday
episodes.plot: Heon agrees to spend a Saturday with Sol-i, who wants to take him to see his favorite soccer team. But his mood soon sours.

translations.value: Heon agrees to spend a Saturday with Sol-i, who wants to take him to see his favorite soccer team. But his mood soon sours.

episodes.name: We Need to Talk
episodes.plot: When a confession note makes Sol-i awkward around him, Dae-sung assures her it was a joke. Jin-hwan gets help facing his bullies.

translations.value: When a confession note makes Sol-i awkward around him, Dae-sung assures her it was a joke. Jin-hwan gets help facing his bullies.

episodes.name: Don't Worry.mp3
episodes.plot: With the flu going around, Sol-i frets when she has a cough and is sent to the school nurse's office. Heon looks out for her in his own way.

translations.value: With the flu going around, Sol-i frets when she has a cough and is sent to the school nurse's office. Heon looks out for her in his own way.

episodes.name: White Christmas
episodes.plot: It's almost Christmas! While Sol-i racks her brains on what to get Heon, her parents wonder whether their daughter has a crush on someone.

translations.value: It's almost Christmas! While Sol-i racks her brains on what to get Heon, her parents wonder whether their daughter has a crush on someone.

episodes.name: Declaration of Love
episodes.plot: When the class goes on a trip outdoors, Sol-i plans a surprise event for Heon. Jin-hwan ruins Kang Ha-young's night at the movies.

translations.value: When the class goes on a trip outdoors, Sol-i plans a surprise event for Heon. Jin-hwan ruins Kang Ha-young's night at the movies.

episodes.name: Raindrop
episodes.plot: Knowing he's hurt Sol-i's feelings, Heon attempts to apologize. A visibly troubled Oh Hui-ji acts out of character.

translations.value: Knowing he's hurt Sol-i's feelings, Heon attempts to apologize. A visibly troubled Oh Hui-ji acts out of character.

episodes.name: Four-Leaf Clover
episodes.plot: Hui-ji steals from the school nurse's office. Jin-hwan stops coming to school when he finds out about Ha-young's crush on someone else.

translations.value: Hui-ji steals from the school nurse's office. Jin-hwan stops coming to school when he finds out about Ha-young's crush on someone else.

episodes.name: University, University, University!
episodes.plot: Sol-i learns that Heon wants to attend a prestigious university. Dae-sung's worsening arm injury threatens his swimming career.

translations.value: Sol-i learns that Heon wants to attend a prestigious university. Dae-sung's worsening arm injury threatens his swimming career.

episodes.name: Collect Our Dreams
episodes.plot: Heon's plans for his future don't align with what his mother wants. When Dae-sung's grandmother goes missing, Heon and Sol-i also look for her.

translations.value: Heon's plans for his future don't align with what his mother wants. When Dae-sung's grandmother goes missing, Heon and Sol-i also look for her.

episodes.name: First Kiss
episodes.plot: As all her friends get accepted into college, Sol-i feels down about herself. Heon encourages her to keep trying, and promises he'll help.

translations.value: As all her friends get accepted into college, Sol-i feels down about herself. Heon encourages her to keep trying, and promises he'll help.

episodes.name: Love Generation
episodes.plot: Sol-i is elated when Heon makes their relationship official. Not wanting to worry Ha-young, Jin-hwan keeps a secret from her.

translations.value: Sol-i is elated when Heon makes their relationship official. Not wanting to worry Ha-young, Jin-hwan keeps a secret from her.

episodes.name: Farewell Formula
episodes.plot: Struggling in her job search and with putting up with Heon's demanding work schedule, Sol-i snaps when she finds out he may be leaving for America.

translations.value: Struggling in her job search and with putting up with Heon's demanding work schedule, Sol-i snaps when she finds out he may be leaving for America.

episodes.name: It's Been A While
episodes.plot: Hearing her dad's been hospitalized, Sol-i hurries over — and bumps into Heon, who's back in Korea. All the friends gather for drinks.

translations.value: Hearing her dad's been hospitalized, Sol-i hurries over — and bumps into Heon, who's back in Korea. All the friends gather for drinks.

episodes.name: Your Wedding
episodes.plot: Sol-i calls Heon about his actions the night before. Everyone comes together for Ha-young and Jin-hwan's wedding.

translations.value: Sol-i calls Heon about his actions the night before. Everyone comes together for Ha-young and Jin-hwan's wedding.

episodes.name: Begin Again
episodes.plot: Heon shows up to a gathering in his old school uniform, and gets honest about his feelings. Dae-sung decides it's time to bare his heart to Sol-i.

translations.value: Heon shows up to a gathering in his old school uniform, and gets honest about his feelings. Dae-sung decides it's time to bare his heart to Sol-i.

episodes.name: Dear My Honey
episodes.plot: A lovely surprise awaits Sol-i outside of Heon's hospital. The next day, Sol-i's parents come to visit her without notice.

translations.value: A lovely surprise awaits Sol-i outside of Heon's hospital. The next day, Sol-i's parents come to visit her without notice.

episodes.name: From, Honey
episodes.plot: Looking back on all they've endured together, Heon recounts for Sol-i how he came to fall in love with her.

translations.value: Looking back on all they've endured together, Heon recounts for Sol-i how he came to fall in love with her.

translations.title: A Love So Beautiful
translations.overview: Love is as tough as it is sweet for a lovestruck teenager, whose relationship with her next-door neighbor transforms as they grow into adulthood.

translations.title: 아름다웠던 우리에게
translations.overview: 명랑 발랄한 여고생 신솔이와 그녀가 17년째 짝사랑하는 옆집 소꿉친구 차헌, 그리고 이들과 청춘을 함께했던 친구들의 이야기를 담은 첫사랑 소환 로맨스물
